operation.description: #840: the workspace's effective guardrail rules with provenance: its platform layer (override or type default), its local layer and each effective entry's source, revision, tightening entries and active/inactive_reason (egress_not_allowed under local_only, tightened_rule_missing for an entry whose platform rule is gone). Custom pattern text is shown to the layer's writers and, for platform layers and a shared workspace's local layer, to platform staff; everyone else sees pattern_count. Members and, on a Team or Project, platform staff read; a personal workspace is its owner's only. Input rules are enforced by the engine for generation and embeddings (enforced is true); output is not inspected in this release.

Input rules are enforced by the engine for generation and embeddings (enforced is true); output is not inspected in this release.

operation.description: #840: replace the workspace's local layer (full set): rules of its own, and tightening entries ({tightens: <platform rule id>} with only input.action, output.mode, on_error or threshold) that make a platform rule stricter. Composition takes the stricter value of each field, so an entry never weakens the current platform rule. Shared owners/admins and a personal workspace's owner; browser only. local_only is a platform field (400). Input rules are enforced by the engine for generation and embeddings (enforced is true); output is not inspected in this release.

GuardrailRuleInput.description: A rule. Rules the schema cannot state: categories include custom exactly when patterns are given (1 to 50, at most 50 per layer, each at most 512 bytes and compiling within the pattern limits: guardrail_pattern_invalid).

GuardrailTighteningInput.description: A tightening entry (local layers only). Rules the schema cannot state: tightens names a rule of the workspace's current platform layer, once; at least one of input.action, output.mode and on_error is given; each is at least as strict as the platform rule's (guardrail_loosen_not_allowed).
